opener_concept: Two square tile-trays, sides 3 and 6 tiles, filled with the same square tiles. The student computes 3x3=9 and 6x6=36 by pure common sense, sees the side doubled but the tile count went times four (because 2 squared = 4), and that IS area proportional to side squared: A = k s squared. Honestly names the find-k-then-use method with a power. Inline theme-safe SVG shows the two squares to scale (currentColor strokes/text, soft fills).
